description: Validate EU VAT numbers in bulk against the official VIES service, plus Norway (Brreg) and Switzerland (UID register): valid/invalid, company name, address and the VIES consultation number as audit proof. A member-state outage is reported as unavailable, never as invalid. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.003/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/eu-vat-number-validation.

defaultCountry.description: Optional 2-letter country code used for numbers given without a prefix, e.g. DE. Leave empty if every number has its prefix.

requesterVatNumber.description: Optional. Your company's EU VAT number with prefix. VIES then returns an official consultation number per check, which you can keep as proof for a tax audit (EU numbers only).

vatNumbers.description: VAT numbers with country prefix, up to 100 per run. Spaces, dots and dashes are fine. EU: DE811569869, IE6388047V, EL... for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland. Norway: NO923609016MVA. Switzerland: CHE-116.281.710 MWST.
